title: Pilot: Shorts v2, Showrunner cut (tiger, roach)
_note: research/39 persona + research/38 Shorts v2: opens on a moving full-frame photo with the claim stated as a fact, no quiz card or countdown, a new picture every <=3 s, loop seam kept (tail ends on the hook's first picture at zoom 1.0). Same facts as originals-01 tiger + roach.

beats.say: Tigers aren't just striped on the fur. Shave one, and the skin underneath is striped too.
beats.loop_say: I'm not saying you should try it. I'm just saying,
beats.short_title: Is a Tiger's Skin Striped Too? 🐯
beats.bonus: No two tigers have the same stripe pattern.
beats.comment: Who else thought it was just the fur? 👇

beats.say: And every tiger's stripe pattern is different, like a fingerprint.
So if one eats you, you'll know exactly who did it.
Which is a small comfort. For you. I'm the one made of meat.
Stripes, all the way down. Meatball, also all the way down. Unfortunately.
A cockroach can live for a week without its head. That's not a myth. That's a cockroach.
beats.loop_say: And people call me the gross one. Meanwhile,
beats.short_title: Can a Cockroach Really Live Without Its Head? 🪳
beats.bonus: Cockroaches can hold their breath for around forty minutes.
beats.comment: Have you ever seen one keep going after you hit it? 👇

beats.say: It breathes through tiny holes along its body, not through its head. So the head was basically optional.
With no mouth, it can't drink. So after about a week, it dies of thirst.
I lose one bite, and they call it dinner.
Headless. Still fine. Honestly, the most confident thing I have ever met.
